newsitem.title: USA: Computer Data buys company for $51 mln.
newsitem.headline: Computer Data buys company for $51 mln.

text.p: Computer Data Systems Inc said Friday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Analytical Systems Engineering Corp for $51 million.
Computer Data said it expects Analytical to contribute between $75 million and $80 million in revenues in fiscal 1998.
It said it expects the contribution to earnings per share to be minimal for fiscal 1998, but should be increasingly accretive in fiscal 1999 and beyond.
Ninety percent of the purchase price will be paid in cash and 10 percent will be paid in shares of Computer Data stock valued for purposes of the agreement at $27.50 per share.
Analytical Systems is a privately held provider of engineering and technical services primarily to the intelligence community and to Department of Defense agencies.
